summary_1line: As the Pandavas begin their incognito year, Yudhishthira prays to Durga, who appears and promises them future victory over the Kauravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands with folded hands in the forest as the radiant multi‑armed goddess Durga appears before him in celestial light.
The Pandavas hide their bows and swords high in a tree and hang a corpse beneath it to frighten away curious villagers.
Durga, adorned with weapons, snakes, and peacock plumes, speaks a prophecy of victory to the kneeling Yudhishthira.
